name: Pokémon Otherside
storyline:
Eighty-one years ago, a war broke out between the Republics of Alterria and Subaria over the mysterious energy known as Techna. After a fragile truce, both nations experienced rapid technological growth, strongly influenced by the Nezia corporation.

In this context, a tragic accident at the Ghessa laboratory caused the disappearance of several scientists, changing the lives of many families. Fifteen years later, in the town of Couvre-Vent, a new adventurer sets out on a journey across two brand-new regions. Their quest for truth will uncover the consequences of technology, the discovery of new Pokémon and Fakemon, and crucial choices that will shape the fate of both nations.
summary:
Pokémon Otherside is an independent fangame RPG that offers a brand-new adventure in a completely original universe.
It introduces an original region, over 150 new Fakemon, new forms such as Mega Evolutions, as well as new types like Tech.
With its focus on story and player choices, unique abilities and talents, and an innovative Pokémon management system, Pokémon Otherside provides a rich experience inspired by classic RPGs.
